tasks.title: Delete legacy review-post.md and update docs
tasks.description:
Remove the legacy single-file review log and update all documentation for the per-round system.

1. `git rm .ralph/review-post.md` (git history preserves it — do not archive or copy it anywhere).
2. CLAUDE.md updates: (a) in the 'Per-project data layout' tree, add `.ralph/reviews/` ('round-<N>.md — per-planning-round post-task review logs') and update the state.json comment from '{ "nextTaskId": N }' to include the round field, e.g. '{ "nextTaskId": N, "round": R }'; (b) in the Agent workflow section, update the sentence about the post-task reviewer running 'with a path-scoped allowlist that excludes .ralph/tasks.json' to describe the directory-scoped rule covering .ralph/reviews/**; (c) mention that `ralph plan` bumps the round counter.
3. README.md updates: line ~300's data-layout tree entry for state.json ('Monotonic task-ID counter — never reuses IDs') — extend for the round counter, and add the reviews/ directory to that tree.
4. Scrub any remaining `review-post.md` references repo-wide: `grep -rn review-post . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git` must return no hits in source, tests, agents/, .claude/, or docs (checks test/commands/init.test.ts, test/commands/plan.test.ts, test/agent-prompt.test.ts among others; as of planning, those three had no references — verify nothing regressed).
5. Run the full suite to confirm nothing referenced the deleted file.

Docs-and-deletion task; no new unit tests required beyond the grep gate and the full suite.
tasks.notes:
# Task #30: Delete legacy review-post.md and update docs

## What changed

1. `git rm -f .ralph/review-post.md` — deleted the legacy single-file review log (git history preserves prior content; had uncommitted local review appends from tasks #27/#28 in the working tree that were discarded, per the task's explicit "do not archive or copy it anywhere" instruction).

2. `CLAUDE.md`:
   - Per-project data layout tree: `state.json` comment now reads `Monotonic task-ID counter + planning round { "nextTaskId": N, "round": R } — committed to git`; added `reviews/` directory with `round-<N>.md — Per-planning-round post-task review logs`.
   - Agent workflow section: appended a sentence noting `state.json` also tracks the planning round, that `ralph plan` bumps it on every planning run, and that the post-task reviewer writes to `.ralph/reviews/round-<N>.md` for the active round.
   - Updated the tasks.json-protection sentence: "path-scoped allowlist that excludes `.ralph/tasks.json`" → "directory-scoped allowlist covering only `.ralph/reviews/**`, which excludes `.ralph/tasks.json`" — matches the actual `reviewFileRule` glob in `src/post-task-reviewer.ts` (task #28).

3. `README.md` (Per-project data tree, ~line 293-308): extended the `state.json` comment to "Monotonic task-ID counter + planning round — never reuses IDs (committed to git)"; added `reviews/round-<N>.md` entry.

## Verification

- `grep -rn "review-post" . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git`: remaining hits are all in `.ralph/` task-tracking/history artifacts (`tasks.json`, `tasks.completed.json`, `.ralph_tasks_snapshot.json`, `planning-notes.md`, `.ralph_task_28/29_notes.md` — all historical record of this and prior tasks, not source/docs) plus one intentional negative-assertion in `test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts` (`expect(prompt).not.toContain("review-post.md")` — asserting the string's *absence*, which is correct and expected).
- `grep -n "review-post" test/commands/init.test.ts test/commands/plan.test.ts test/agent-prompt.test.ts` → no hits (confirmed clean, as expected from planning).
- `bun test` → 730 pass, 0 fail, 1443 expect() calls. No test referenced the deleted file.
- `bun run build` → compiles clean.

## Notes for next agent

- `.ralph/tasks.json`, `.ralph/tasks.completed.json`, and `.ralph/.ralph_tasks_snapshot.json` still contain historical string mentions of `review-post.md` inside old task descriptions/notes — this is expected and correct (immutable historical record of what was asked/done in past iterations), not something to scrub.
- This was the last task in the current planning round — 0 remaining pending/in-progress tasks after this one.
